testResults.name: run-nano
testResults.stdout:
Nano local chain tools
Usage: nano <init|status|audit|mine|validate|import|serve|run> <genesis.json> <database-directory> [arguments]
  wallet <create|import|address|sign-message|sign-transaction|sign-typed-data> <keyfile> [data]
  wallet deployment-address <keyfile> [nonce]
  wallet create-many <new-directory> [count] (default: 10)
  wallet hd-create <mnemonic-file> [word-count]; wallet hd-derive <keyfile> [index]
  rpc <URL> <info|nodes|network|balance|send|deploy|receipt|mine> [arguments]
  rpc <URL> <stake-register|stake-add> <keyfile> <contract> <amountNano>
  rpc <URL> stake-withdraw <keyfile> <contract>
  rpc <URL> deploy <keyfile> <bytecode-file> [timeout] [valueNano]
  validator <config.json> [--once] (separate client)
  init/status: show canonical chain status
  mine/validate: <coinbase> <timestamp> [signed-raw-transactions.json]
  audit-capella <genesis.json> <existing-database-directory> <audit-request.json> (offline canonical replay)
  beacon-journal init <identity.json> <new-database> <new-receipt-directory>
  beacon-journal status <identity.json> <database> <expected-commitment.json>
  beacon-journal export <identity.json> <database> <expected-commitment.json> <new-receipt-directory>
  beacon-journal import <identity.json> <database> <expected-commitment.json> <interchange.json> <max-bytes> <new-receipt-directory>
  migrate: <genesis.json> <python-chaindb-directory> <new-database-directory>
  import: <block.json> <current-timestamp>
  run: [node-config.json] (RPC and P2P together)
  serve: [port] [bind-address] [wallet-config.json] (defaults: 8545, 127.0.0.1)
